(2) In the SAME package the SQL treats gen_powerofattorney.gen_agentname as a contact id and gen_agencyname as an account id: 'join contact on gen_agentname = contactid' + 'join Gen_agents on Gen_agents.gen_contactname = gen_agentname' (Get Agent DTSX:31644-31645), 'join account on gen_agencyname = accountid' + 'join Gen_agencie on Gen_agencie.gen_agencyname = Gen_powerofattorney.gen_agencyname' (Get Agencie DTSX:31565-31566), 'left join Contact on Contact.ContactId=poa.Gen_agentname' / 'Account.AccountId=poa.Gen_agencyname' (DTSX:27226 source).
